app.titleVi: Grand Stickman Spider Fighting: Liên minh siêu anh hùng
app.descr:
Stick man is an action-packed brawler where you take on the role of a customizable stick man hero and battle your way through hordes of enemies using your fists, feet, and a variety of wacky weapons. The game's physics-based combat system makes for hilarious and over-the-top action, as you send your enemies flying with ragdoll throws, grapple them with your tongue, or launch them into the air with powerful kicks.
Here are just a few of the things you can do in Stick man Showdown:

Customize your hero: Choose from a variety of costumes and hats to make your stick man stand out from the crowd.

Wreak havoc: Use your fists, feet, and weapons to beat down your enemies in a flurry of punches, kicks, and throws.

Get physical: The game's physics-based combat system makes for some truly outrageous moments, as you send your enemies flying through the air or ragdoll them into walls.

Challenge your friends: Battle your friends in local multiplayer mode or climb the online leaderboards to see who is the ultimate stick-man.
